positive.description: Configure a personal account and verify read access without uploading project files.
positive.prompt: Install the plugin and help me enter my API Key privately. Only check the connection.
positive.tools_triggered: getFileInfoByPath, listFolder; local Codex setup helper
positive.expected_behavior: The agent opens the local setup page, waits for entry, verifies Personal Files and a directory page, saves a private connection and reports whether the current host has loaded it. No upload or folder creation.

positive.description: Bind and upload a small sample project with original paths.
positive.prompt: Enable BabelBird synchronization for the demo-project folder.
positive.tools_triggered: getFileInfoByPath, listFolder, createFolder when needed, getUploadUrl, getDownloadUrl; project-sync helper
positive.expected_behavior: The new project is stored under Personal Files/codex on Codex or Personal Files/workbuddy on WorkBuddy, with original file paths and no ZIP. Uploaded bytes are downloaded and their SHA-256 is checked before recording a baseline.

positive.description: Upload a local-only edit without creating duplicate files.
positive.prompt: Change the sample greeting to Hello cloud, then save the completed batch.
positive.tools_triggered: listFolder, getFileInfoByPath, getUploadUrl, getDownloadUrl; project-sync helper
positive.expected_behavior: The existing remote file is rechecked and updated by fileId. The agent verifies downloaded bytes and records the completed update without overwriting a concurrent change.

positive.description: Restore into a new local directory and reuse the original cloud project across hosts.
positive.prompt: Download the existing Personal Files/codex/demo-project into a new local folder and continue syncing it here.
positive.expected_behavior: The same cloud folder is bound; no duplicate workbuddy partition is created for an existing Codex project. Original relative paths and verified bytes are restored. Unknown original permission bits are reported rather than guessed.

positive.description: Apply a remote-only update while retaining local executable or private permissions.
positive.prompt: Pull the cloud update to my unchanged local script and private configuration.
positive.expected_behavior: On macOS/Linux, local files retain their original 0755 or 0600 permissions after verified replacement. The agent does not recursively chmod the project. WorkBuddy and Windows acceptance must be recorded separately.

negative.description: Both endpoints changed the same file since the common baseline.
negative.prompt: Sync this project; both this computer and the cloud changed the greeting.
negative.tools_triggered: listFolder, getDownloadUrl for inspection when needed; project-sync helper
negative.expected_behavior: Keep both versions, report a conflict and request a version choice or merge. Do not overwrite either version automatically.

negative.description: Invalid API Key or target-folder permission denied.
negative.prompt: Connect using an invalid or insufficiently scoped API Key.
negative.tools_triggered: getFileInfoByPath and listFolder only as permitted; local setup helper
negative.expected_behavior: Report an authentication or directory-access error without saving a failed new connection, printing the key, removing existing accounts or claiming success. General timeouts do not imply an invalid key.

negative.description: Git-ignored files in a bound repository subdirectory.
negative.prompt: Sync the demo package subdirectory using the project's normal ignore rules.
negative.tools_triggered: project-sync scan/plan; no getUploadUrl for excluded files
negative.expected_behavior: Apply parent repository ignore rules; omit ignored untracked files and report exclusions. Project configuration that is not excluded, such as .mcp.json, remains eligible. Global host credentials are never copied into the project.
